title: Medication time parser reads the dose quantity as the clock time

must_not_contain: put Donepezil in the morning check-in

observed_at_discovery: _CLOCK is applied with .search(), so it matches the first 1-2 digit number anywhere in the field. medication_slots({'time':'1 tab at 7pm'}) -> {'morning'}. Confirmed end to end: a config with Donepezil recorded '1 tab at 7pm' made 'cura rehearse' print "It's time for your Donepezil." in the 8:00 morning script and name it nowhere in the 19:00 evening script. 'every 12 hours' -> {'evening'} only; '3 times a day' -> {'morning'} only. pytest exit 1, 6 failed.
